content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195 on earth. PayPal can suspend your account and hold funds for 180 days with no appeal. If you sell digital art in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, or other regions where these platforms are unavailable or hostile, you need a structural alternative — not a workaround. This is how sovereign commerce infrastructure works at the base layer. It is not a replacement for Stripe or PayPal. It is a permanent shift to owning your stack.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital paypal

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto|complete]] digital commerce stack that you own and control. It is built from free and paid tools that do not rely on Stripe, PayPal, or any single platform. The architecture is designed to handle hosting, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-costing-you-4|Why Payment]] processing, order storage, and file delivery without depending on third-party services that exclude or penalize specific regions. This is not a temporary fix. It is a base-layer system that gives you full data ownership and operational autonomy. The stack is deployed on services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This infrastructure is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities, not hypotheticals.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack begins with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. This site displays your digital art and integrates with a backend built on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. When a buyer purchases a product, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. This webhook fires the moment the payment confirms, updating the order in Supabase or Google Sheets. The system then generates a secure, time-limited download link for the digital art, stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The buyer receives this link instantly via email, configured with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to ensure deliverability. Every component is modular and replaceable. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. There are no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no access retained by COREMERCH after handoff.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors and platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or digital art in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this stack is designed for you. It addresses the specific challenges of financial exclusion, currency instability, and platform hostility. The system is not a workaround for temporary restrictions. It is a permanent alternative that gives you control over your commerce operations. By owning your stack, you eliminate the risk of account suspensions, fund holds, and geographic exclusions. This is infrastructure sovereignty — not renting, but owning.
Stripe operates in only 46 countries. Your stack should work in all 195.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which execute functions like payment verification and email generation. Order storage is provided by Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring data persistence without relying on proprietary databases. File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and scalable. Payment processing is managed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a 0.5% fee with no KYC requirements. Each component is selected for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and compatibility with the others. The entire stack is configured to work seamlessly, with end-to-end testing before handoff to ensure operational integrity.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by selecting the components that best fit your needs. If you want a fully managed solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing. Alternatively, you can follow the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to deploy the stack yourself using the provided documentation and source code. Begin by setting up your hosting and backend logic, then integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Configure order storage and file delivery, and test the entire system before going live. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure and can scale it as needed. There are no ongoing fees, no platform dependencies, and no access retained by COREMERCH. This is your stack, built to last.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you need a payment processor that does not exclude regions. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. It integrates with your backend via webhooks, triggering order fulfillment the moment payment confirms on-chain. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10. This eliminates geographic restrictions and gives you a global payment solution without depending on Stripe or PayPal.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days. Own your payment infrastructure instead.

If you are looking for a Stripe alternative in Nigeria or a Gumroad replacement in restricted countries, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete solution deployed in 48 hours. It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with 5 products loaded and email deliverability configured. For a DIY approach, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers full documentation and source code. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to choose the stack that fits your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Select your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Choose your backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Configure file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate payment processing with NOWPayments. Test the entire stack end-to-end before going live. Deploy your products and configure email deliverability with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Monitor transactions and scale as needed. Own your infrastructure — no platform dependencies.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Yes, this stack is designed for creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or hostile. It uses globally accessible services like Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments to ensure you can sell digital products without geographic restrictions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a reliable service, but if it experiences issues, you can replace it with another crypto payment processor. The stack is modular, so you retain full control over your infrastructure and can swap components as needed.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this stack?

Basic technical skills are helpful, but the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment and 30-day support. If you prefer a DIY approach, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides detailed documentation and source code to guide you through the process.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes, the stack is designed for scalability. You can add more products, increase storage, and handle higher transaction volumes without changing the underlying architecture. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for advanced scaling.
What if I need help after deployment?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes 30-day support, and the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides access to documentation and community resources. COREMERCH does not retain access to your stack after deployment, ensuring full ownership and control.
